ChurchStream is free software for **Seventh-day Adventist churches**: live streaming to YouTube and Facebook plus projection of hymns, Bible readings and announcements, from one simple control panel. It runs on Windows and Mac.

## Download

| Computer | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows** laptop or PC | **[ChurchStream-Setup.exe](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v1.2.0/ChurchStream-Setup.exe)** (installer, recommended) · or [ChurchStream-win-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v1.2.0/ChurchStream-win-x64.zip) (no installer, e.g. for a USB stick) |
| **Mac with an Apple chip** (M1–M4) | **[ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v1.2.0/ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Intel processor** | **[ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v1.2.0/ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip)** |

The other files on this page (`ChurchStream-app-…`, `ffmpeg-…`, `update.json`) are for ChurchStream's own updates; you don't need to download them.

**Already on 1.0 or 1.1?** Click **Update** on the card in the control panel: only a few MB are downloaded.

## New in 1.2.0

Videos and music you can pause and move through, a key for the logo, and many fixes that make a service run more smoothly.

### Videos, music and YouTube
- **Pause / Resume** for video and music files. While paused, the stream keeps the last picture and goes quiet; the projector and the room's speakers pause too.
- **Move through a track:** drag or tap the bar under the player, or use **‹ 10 s** and **10 s ›**. Drag it before pressing Play to start part-way through. The projector and the stream jump together.
- The projector's copy keeps in step with the stream, and jumping no longer makes it blink.
- With **"It already reaches the stream through our sound desk"**, videos and music now play in the room again (they were silent).

### Keys
- **L** turns the church logo on and off. **The name (lower third) has moved to N**, the same key as on the stream page.

### More reliable during a service
- Fixed several rare ways ChurchStream could stop during a service (a mistyped address on the church Wi-Fi, a damaged Bible file, FFmpeg stopping at the wrong moment).
- Recordings are named in your local time and are never overwritten if the stream restarts during the service. Closing ChurchStream waits for the recording to finish.
- Pressing **Go live** on a second device no longer restarts the stream, and an old thank-you screen can no longer end a new stream.
- Starting a video no longer interrupts the stream's sound; a video whose file is missing says so instead of showing black.

### The right thing on screen
- Pressing **Enter** straight after typing a hymn number shows that hymn, never the one for the shorter number.
- Saving a song that's on the screens updates them straight away.
- The stream no longer shows an older slide when slides change quickly.
- Phones, tablets and the stage screen notice a dropped Wi-Fi connection and reconnect; the stage screen shows when it's out of date. The phone remote no longer misses taps while streaming.
- Words along the bottom stay clear of the name and the ticker.

### Smaller improvements
- Editors ask before closing with unsaved changes. Order-of-service cards work with the keyboard.
- A failed action no longer shows a success message; volunteer mode can't add songs or undo.
- Fixes to YouTube downloads (Cancel really cancels), the phone camera, the projector window, service files with large videos, and the manual.

## Good to know
- Projecting or streaming hymns still under copyright needs your church's **CCLI** licence (and the Streaming Licence for online use).
- ChurchStream is an independent project, not an official product of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.
